Pb+Pb 30-50% 5.02 TeV collisions, D^0 and D_s^+ v2
two columns encompass the uncertainty from with or without
hadronic phase diffusion. For D_s^+, the lower bound of the band should be favored since it is unlikely to significantly participate in the hadronic phase interaction, whereas for D^0 the upper boundary of the band should be favored.
